name: beryl
description: A local dashboard of your work with Claude: Claude Code sessions, your claude.ai data export and, optionally, a folder of notes. Gives every Claude Code session the context of its project.

claude_code.title: Read Claude Code sessions
claude_code.description: Show your Claude Code sessions (from ~/.claude/projects) and group them into projects.

claude_export.title: claude.ai data export
claude_export.description: Optional. The .zip from claude.ai (Settings > Privacy > Export data), its conversations.json, or a folder that receives the exports, such as Downloads (the newest one is used).

notes_dir.title: Notes folder
notes_dir.description: Optional. An Obsidian vault or any folder of markdown notes. Notes with type: project become projects.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the dashboard and of what Beryl writes in your notes: auto (your system's) or a code such as en or pt. Languages Beryl doesn't have yet fall back to English.

write_notes.title: Write to project notes
write_notes.description: Let Beryl change the status of project notes and add session summaries to them. Off: summaries stay in Beryl's own data.

mcp_only_projects.title: Beryl only in my projects
mcp_only_projects.description: Claude sessions get Beryl's context only in your projects' folders and in the notes folder. Off: in any folder, including repositories cloned from others.
